native_contracts.acceptance: All real-model contracts, bounds and failure semantics pass.

binding_conformance.acceptance: Exact ordered outputs across the same native binary (JavaScript objects in ECMAScript property order); Rust layouts and TS consumer compilation agree with the public ABI/API.

upstream_reference.acceptance: Same-model/backend upstream agreement within declared tolerance; prompt and calibration semantics preserved.

abi.acceptance: Exports, layouts, status constants and installed consumer compatibility match ABI 1.

installed_packages.acceptance: Actual C/C++, Rust, npm/TS/Electron and browser artifacts work outside the checkout.

sanitizers.acceptance: Strict ASan/UBSan/leak checks cover real-model and model-free paths; concurrency tooling coverage explicitly recorded.

stress.acceptance: One-hour routine stress and eight-hour candidate soak meet frozen resource budgets without leaks, hangs or corrupted results.

linux_matrix.acceptance: Every required userspace/ISA/compiler/runtime combination passes installed-artifact checks; physical CPU evidence is separate.

browser_wasm.acceptance: Real-browser WASM semantics, lifecycle, asset deployment and same-backend upstream agreement pass.

browser_webgpu.acceptance: Real-hardware WebGPU semantics, device-loss behavior and same-backend upstream agreement pass.

license_inventory.acceptance: Distributed component/model license obligations and exact artifact provenance reviewed; complete checksum-covered SBOM.

reproducibility.acceptance: Independent native/browser builds and deterministic packages match under identical pinned inputs.

artifact_integrity.acceptance: Sources, binary/assets and runtime identity match; stale/swapped/modified artifacts rejected; final artifacts have verifiable provenance.

performance.acceptance: Repeated baselines and candidate measurements meet predeclared per-profile latency, memory, throughput and responsiveness budgets.

security_review.acceptance: Threat boundaries, pinned dependency advisories and release permissions reviewed; no unresolved release-blocking issue.

upgrade_rollback.acceptance: Runtime/model candidate axes and rollback rehearsed; failed, missing or mismatched evidence cannot qualify a candidate.

cross_profile_drift.acceptance: Identified native/WASM/WebGPU profiles preserve ordered result structures and metadata. Report finite numeric drift and changed decisions on identical model bytes and fixtures; no cross-profile equivalence promise. Each backend must separately pass strict upstream agreement.

notes: This file defines requirements, not successful qualification or a supported-platform claim.
Default browser launch must work; experimental flags are exploratory evidence only.
A report boolean alone does not prove identity, security, provenance or publication readiness.
